correctness.rationale: Reflection and independent killing give the defective Brownian hitting density and Laplace transform. The standardized conditional density is φ(v) times (1+v/√q)^(−3/2) exp(v³/[2√q(1+v/√q)]) on v>−√q. On |v|≤q^(1/12) its linear correction is (v³−3v)/(2√q) with the stated integrable Gaussian-weighted remainder. The exact conditional MGF satisfies log M_q(t)≤t² for |t|≤√q/4, so ±q^(1/12)/2 as Chernoff parameters control the complement. Thus the first-order absolute integral is E|Z³−3Z|/(4√q), yielding the positive stated C_*. The binomial success count with p=m/N and iid conditional marks may be coupled first in its count and then in its marks, giving the bound mδ_q+m²/N. The one-point sector over the sign-positive density set gives the lower bound, because its binomial/Poisson mass difference is O_m(N^−1). The min distribution follows from the exact absence-of-points formula and subtraction of the no-success atom. Given the first successful particle and time, the other particles are independently conditioned on no success by that time; being alive and unabsorbed is a subset of that event, giving the ratio in Eq. (5). Compact success-conditioned mark windows force the conditional binomial mean to infinity uniformly and give log mean log N−q/2−v√q/2+o(1), with vanishing relative count error. Tightness then yields the joint limit including vanishing probability of no other live searcher. This gives a process-level order, not a process-level leading constant. The live population is √N times a random subpower factor, not Θ(√N) in the sense of a multiplicatively tight ratio.

value.rationale: The natural window keeps the eventual number of successes nondegenerate. A sharp whole-cloud approximation quantifies errors for all successful-arrival statistics, while the joint live-count limit gives an informative population response that a first-hitting-time law alone misses. At a given first-arrival mark, the log count resolves a diverging fluctuation scale despite vanishing relative binomial noise. The value is in this quantitative joint description, not in the known threshold.
